completeCopyContract.capture: Capture only one directly witnessed resolved component that actually expresses one profile below. Record canonical source/event, actual original spell rank or pre-encounter monster effective rank, native magnitude before external bonuses/defenses, selected type/profile and qualifying own casting route. For monster abilities without a spell rank, use max(1, min(9, ceil(actualCR/2))); missing CR needs a rating assigned before the encounter, never a favorable after-the-fact guess. No unique/legendary/boss feature without an independently reviewed exception; no copying copies, class engines, actions, resources, permanent changes, resurrection, creation, items or protected information. An unsupported role is ineligible, not a blank Director permission.
completeCopyContract.rankAndPayment: For original rank 0, q=0; otherwise q=max(1, floor(originalRank/2)). The chosen actual owned spellcasting route must independently support learning q; merely owning a pool or feat prerequisite does not. Use that route’s real ability for attack/DC and spell components V/S, normal rank price 0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26 plus actual adjustments. It grants a temporary feat-copy route only, never the original full spell. Spellcasting time is oneAction. At release pay/cast/history/interrupt once, with copy-provenance flags disabling copy/resource/class-proc chains. An explicit source such as Mirrorsage retains its own actual profile/rank/payment instead of being silently converted. FINAL FS-08: these releases are paid feat-copy casts with actual RP/components/history, not ordinary knowledge grants. Boon uses one feat-copy-boon family; its repeated copies do not add, while genuinely distinct eligible ordinary feat bonuses use FS-03.
completeCopyContract.numericBound: For numeric damage/heal/ward select one witnessed native component/type and record its rolled or fixed magnitude B before external bonuses, saves, defenses and recipient caps. If that magnitude was hidden, the Director records it privately; no free identification is given. At feat-copy release roll (q+1)d6, then bound the native numeric result to min(roll, floor(B/2)). No copied critical multiplier, external damage/heal modifier, converted excess or extra recipients. Actual recipient defenses and healing limits still apply. A zero ceiling cannot produce a numeric benefit. This is an explicit NEW meaning of half potency, not an assertion about original undefined wording.
completeCopyContract.lifecycle: At most one feat-copy release per owner per numbered round across Eldritch Echo, Mimicry and adapted copies. A Mirrorsage owner also spends its existing shared release allowance; an unowned Mirrorsage engine is not granted. Strike/Burst/Mend are immediate. Ward/Hindrance/Boon/Step use their stated maximum two-interval duration; source-specific shorter hold deadlines still govern. Only one pending feat-copy record across Eldritch Echo/Mimicry; before a new capture choose whether to replace the old, losing its paid capture/use without refund. Adaptation may retain permission but creates no second release allowance. No copied effect grants extra Action/BA/Reaction, persistent body, loot, learning or concentration capacity.

profiles.resolution: Actual own casting ability+PB spell attack; on hit bounded numeric damage of one observed native type. No added critical dice. No original riders. Instant.

profiles.range: Point within 30 ft;10 ft radius, at most 3 originally declared perceived creatures in area with line of effect
profiles.resolution: DEX save vs own DC for bounded numeric observed-type damage, half on success; one shared roll. No original riders. Instant.

profiles.range: 30 ft one perceived willing living creature with line of effect
profiles.resolution: Restore bounded numeric HP under actual prohibitions/maximum/Critical caps. No reviving, healing dice add-ons, Wound cure, heal-copy/resource trigger or excess conversion. Instant.

profiles.range: 30 ft one perceived willing living creature with line of effect
profiles.resolution: Offer bounded numerictemp HP into the actual single grant ledger, ending at the source’s second future regular start. Rejected offer wastes the copy. No linked riders.

profiles.range: 30 ft one perceived creature with line of effect
profiles.resolution: WIS save vs own DC or Speed−10 ft and no new Reactions until its next future regular end, never later than the source’s second future regular start. Strongest slow arbitration; no wholeAction/turn denial, repeated save or original hard-control rider.

profiles.role: A source actually granting a positive attack, save or AC modifier
profiles.range: 30 ft one perceived willing creature with line of effect
profiles.resolution: Choose one statistic actually benefited by the witnessed source: +1 AC OR+1 to one next actual attack roll OR+1 to one next actual save, through source’s next future regular end. Strongest feat-copy-boon-family arbitration; no new roll or cloned concentration.

profiles.range: Self to visible unoccupied fitting space within min(15 ft, floor(observed distance/2))
profiles.resolution: If original component was teleport, teleport with actual line of effect and ordinary teleport restrictions; otherwise move that distance over an actual legal path paying terrain and provoking normally. No passenger, planar travel, new locomotion mode or movement into an unseen space. Instant.

scope: Exact whole-card source bindings and actual class placement feed seven finite component witnesses. Native damage/ward dice, Lifedraw qualifying damage-to-heal derivation, actual Slow mode/result, Shield AC-only and completed Mist Step distance constrain profile selection and native numeric bounds.
limits: Source-cast payment, repertoire, attack/save/defense resolution, direct perception, actual world geometry and completion are supplied conditional premises; this adapter cannot authenticate a campaign occurrence.

Only seven explicitly named ordinary source procedures are modeled. Rejection of unadapted sources is scope restriction, not a general game ruling that they can never qualify. The separately bound non-healing examples support their specific negative interpretations.

Selecting a witness neither spends nor authorizes capture. Paid Echo/Mimicry/Adaptation acquisition, qualifying own rank route, timing/Reaction/use/rest/copy-record lifecycle and full paid release/counter/casting history remain required.

Native ordinary damage dice exclude external add-ons and separately copied critical multipliers. Actual Lifedraw damage after its own defenses is a premise and is used only to derive the original healing component before the healer maximum/other recipient limits.
No full recipient damage/healing/ward/control/boon/movement application, monster effective rank, protected-feature exception or Mirrorsage engine is executed.
No source-rule adoption, full335 approval, runtime certification, human balance evidence, GitHub push or cosmology review follows.
